scope: Isolated local Atlas, copied current serving tables; not production availability
rubric: Manual building/street comparison against full reference listings. Ignore casing, abbreviation, transliteration and floor/shop detail; require street/number or named premise agreement without a conflicting named facility. Strict address agreement preserves suffix distinctions for comparability with Hype. Numeric-stem agreement additionally ignores suffixes under the requested model policy; it does not verify suffix identity.
